sampleSentences.german: Nach dem Kaffee war ich wieder munter.
sampleSentences.english: After the coffee I was awake again.

sampleSentences.german: Die Kinder spielten munter im Garten.
sampleSentences.english: The children played merrily in the garden.

memoryHook: Munter: wide awake and full of life.

quiz.fullAnswer: Er ist wieder gesund und munter.

goodToKnow: Munter means lively, cheerful or awake: munter werden (to wake up properly), Kaffee macht munter. Gesund und munter means alive and kicking, safe and sound. As an adverb, it can mean happily or merrily, sometimes ironically: Er redete munter weiter (he just kept on talking). Der Muntermacher is a pick-me-up, like coffee. Ermuntern means to encourage. The opposite is müde or schläfrig.
